analysis.reading:
THE SAME FRAGMENTATION, A SECOND TIME, ON THE SAME DAY. On 31 July «alexanarch marx» returned four cards for three men named ALEXANDER MARX. Here «alexanarch whitman» returns two cards for ALEXANDRA WHITMAN. The coined name is being read as a common given name and recombined with whatever follows it — Alexander, Alexandra — producing a person who is not the subject.

This is no longer a one-off. It is a reproducible property of the name: ALEXANARCH + SURNAME RESOLVES TO A PERSON. Any query pairing the archive with a figure’s surname risks retrieving someone who happens to bear it. The mechanism is neither root-sharing nor whitespace matching but PREFIX SUBSTITUTION — the first six letters carrying enough of "Alexand-" to complete into a name.

One of the two collision cards is a local news report of a death. It is recorded as evidence that the collision occurred and nothing further: the person is unconnected to the archive, and there is no measurement to be taken from a stranger’s bereavement. The registry notes the mechanism, not the story.

The three archive cards are exact. The Mantle Protocol is stated in full — "Prince of Poets (originated), Good Gray Poet (inherited from Whitman), King of May (inherited from Ginsberg)" — and located: "PAGE 74 is the site where Lee Sharks claims succession from both Whitman and Ginsberg." A page number, in a citation, for a claim of poetic succession.
